name: varg
description: Generate AI videos, images, speech, and music with varg — Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Wan 3, Veo 3.1, Nano Banana, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more through one API key. Includes the varg-ai, find-references (real references from seven sources and ten visual ideas before anything is made), video-script (the script before anything is made: one promise, beats joined by but/therefore, every line sized to its seconds and checked by a script, six structures with one example each, and variations for demos, reviews, ads, social shorts and short drama), video-moodboard (a moodboard models follow, in the order that matters most: references, light, subject lock, framing, palette, motion, texture, type, sound; drawn as board.html, proved on test stills, with 450+ source links), video-sound (the sound of any video: real-sounding AI voices cast from candidates, dialogue with pauses and breaths, effects on the right frame, music mapped to the beats, and a mix graded by script against platform loudness), character-passport (cast an AI video before anything moves: a one-paragraph passport pasted word for word into every prompt, a turnaround sheet in the moodboard's look, six expressions written as cause + physical tells, a measured voice line, and props with materials, wear and motion; blind-judged on stills and two video models), video-animate (animate once the previz, characters, moodboard, script and sound exist: code or AI per element, Seedance or another model per shot, a cheap pass first, long or short runs, takes that vary only the performance, plates ready for motion design), varg-previz, threejs-animatic (a three.js animatic of every shot: mannequins, sets in metres, a camera per shot, rendered to MP4 as the Seedance video-to-video reference), varg-mockups (HTML review boards of stills to approve before any video is paid for, plus device and UI mockups), varg-video-prompting (which model for which shot, prompt anatomy, what each reference copies, QA and gotchas from paid runs), media-download (save videos from X, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest images, no key needed) and paper-shaders (frame-exact shader backgrounds and logo stings) skills, how-to-make-ai-video and video-skills (how to make any AI video: search varg how to for the right skill, options and steps), varg-publish-skill (publish your own skill to varg how to in the one card format), varg-video-editing (which service to edit existing footage with, job by job), the format skills varg-music-video, varg-character-keynote, varg-consistent-characters and varg-podcast-video, the Kling 4 skills (kling-4-prompting, kling-4-keyframe-film, kling-4-action-montage: cinematic Kling 4 video from key frames), varg-character-design (how to make characters people remember, with sheets that stay consistent in later images and video) and its category recipes (grandmas, big guys, cringe deadpan, beautiful women, fitness, absurd and mascots, cartoon looks), the occasion skills varg-birthday-video and varg-occasion-video (a birthday video with a song that sings the name, invitations, holiday greetings, old photos brought to life and tributes), the ecommerce video set (ecommerce-video-ads, product-video-hooks, tiktok-shop-video, ai-ugc-ad-video, product-photo-to-video, ad-creative-testing, ecommerce-video-edit: viral product videos for TikTok, TikTok Shop, Reels and Meta ads) the motion craft skills with expert-sourced presets for every template (caption-styles, title-design, kinetic-type-art, social-overlays, app-ui-mockups, transition-craft, motion-formats, maps-and-data-motion, footage-effects), video-project-github (keep the whole project in a private GitHub repo: saved versions, undo, media by hash, keys kept out, a new laptop gets it all back), and the hosted varg MCP server.
